passive.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight debuff to deal additional damage.

spells.name: Shield of Daybreak
spells.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.
spells.tooltip: The next basic attack deals an additional <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stuns</status> an enemy for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Eclipse
spells.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Armor and Magic Resistance.  When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.
spells.tooltip: Leona gains <scaleArmor>{{ bonusarmr }} Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for {{ buffduration }} seconds. When the effect ends, nearby enemies struck take <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage> and Leona retains her bonus <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for another {{ buffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Zenith Blade
spells.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.
spells.tooltip: Strikes all enemies in a line dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage>. The last enemy Champion struck will be briefly <status>Rooted</status> and Leona will dash to them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Solar Flare
spells.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area.  Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.
spells.tooltip: Calls down a radiant beam of solar energy dealing <magicDamage>{{ explosioncalculateddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> enemies by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ ccduration }} seconds. Enemies in the center of the flare are <status>Stunned</status>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Lulu.name: Lulu
Jade_Lulu.title: The Fae Sorceress
Jade_Lulu.lore: - Glitterdance (Q) bolts can not deal damage to the same target
Jade_Lulu.blurb: - Glitterdance (Q) bolts can not deal damage to the same target

passive.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
passive.description: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

spells.name: Glitterlance
spells.description: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that heavily slows all enemies it hits. An enemy can only be damaged by one bolt.
spells.tooltip:
Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage, enemies hit are Slowed by {{ slowamount*-100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds.

An enemy can only be damaged by one bolt.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Whimsy
spells.description: If cast on an ally, grants them movement speed and ability power for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.
spells.tooltip:
On Ally Cast: Target ally gains {{ msboost*100 }}% Movement Speed and {{ apboost }} Ability Power for {{ buffduration }} seconds.

On Enemy Cast: Polymorphs an enemy champion for {{ polymorphduration }} seconds, disabling their ability to attack or cast spells and Slows by 60.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Help, Pix!
spells.description: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.
spells.tooltip:
On Ally Cast: Commands Pix to jump to an ally and then follow and aid their attacks instead of Lulu's for {{ allyfollowduration }} seconds. Upon arrival, Pix shields for {{ totalshield }} damage for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

On Enemy Cast: Pix deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to target enemy unit. Pix then follows and grants vision of them for {{ enemyfollowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Wild Growth
spells.description: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip: Lulu enlarges her ally, <status>Knocking Up</status> nearby enemies into the air. For {{ buffduration }} seconds, her ally gains <scaleHealth>{{ totalbonushealth }} bonus health</scaleHealth> and nearby enemies are <status>Slowed</status> by {{ slowpercent }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Lux.name: Lux
Jade_Lux.title: The Lady of Luminosity
Jade_Lux.lore:
- Light Binding's (Q) second target is half as affective
- Final Spark (R) is now German - Finales Funkeln
Jade_Lux.blurb:
- Light Binding's (Q) second target is half as affective
- Final Spark (R) is now German - Finales Funkeln

passive.name: Illumination
passive.description: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage.

spells.name: Light Binding
spells.description: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.
spells.tooltip: Fires a ball of light, <status>Rooting</status> the first enemy hit for 2 seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagett }} magic damage</magicDamage>. The second enemy is dealt <magicDamage>{{ halftotaldamagett }}</magicDamage> and <status>Rooted</status> for 1 second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Prismatic Barrier
spells.description: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.
spells.tooltip: Throws Lux's wand to a target location and back, <shield>shielding</shield> herself and all allied Champions it touches from <shield>{{ totalshieldtt }} damage</shield> for 3 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Lucent Singularity
spells.description: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.
spells.tooltip:
Lux creates a light zone that Slows by {{ slowpercent }}% and reveals the area. After {{ slowzoneduration }} seconds, it detonates, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

Recast to detonate early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Finales Funkeln
spells.description: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area.  In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.
spells.tooltip: Channels a dazzling ray of light dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to all enemies in a line. <spellName>Finales Funkeln</spellName> ignites and refreshes <spellName>Illumination</spellName>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Malphite.name: Malphite
Jade_Malphite.title: Shard of the Monolith
Jade_Malphite.lore: - Brutal Strikes (W) cleave is a passive and actively increases his damage
Jade_Malphite.blurb: - Brutal Strikes (W) cleave is a passive and actively increases his damage

passive.name: Granite Shield
passive.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage. If Malphite has not been hit recently, this effect recharges.

spells.name: Seismic Shard
spells.description: Using his primal elemental magic, Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing their movement speed.
spells.tooltip: Deals <magicDamage>{{ qdamagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> and steals <speed>{{ speedsteal }}% Movement Speed</speed> from the target for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Brutal Strikes
spells.description: Malphite starts to hit with such force that his attacks deal damage to all units in front of him. Activating Brutal Strikes greatly increases his Armor and Attack Damage for a short amount of time.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Malphite's basic attacks hit units near his target for {{ jade_malphiteobduracypercentdamage*100 }}% of his Attack Damage.

Active: Malphite's Armor and Attack Damage increase by {{ armorbonus*100 }}% for {{ buffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ground Slam
spells.description: Malphite slams the ground sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor as damage and reduces the Attack speed of enemies for a short duration.
spells.tooltip:
Malphite slams the ground dealing {{ edamagecalc }} magic damage to surrounding enemies, reducing their Attack Speed by {{ asreduction*-100 }}% for {{ duration }} seconds.

This ability gains damage equal to {{ armorscaling_jade*100 }}% of Malphite's Armor.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Unstoppable Force
spells.description: Malphite ferociously charges to a location, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
spells.tooltip: Malphite charges toward the target area, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Knocking</status> enemies into the air for {{ knockupduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Malzahar.name: Malzahar
Jade_Malzahar.title: The Prophet of the Void
Jade_Malzahar.lore:
- Null Zone (W) is an AoE area for a short time
- Summon Voidling (P) creates a voidling after a number of casts
- Nether Grasp (R) does not have the null zone around the target
Jade_Malzahar.blurb:
- Null Zone (W) is an AoE area for a short time
- Summon Voidling (P) creates a voidling after a number of casts
- Nether Grasp (R) does not have the null zone around the target

passive.name: Summon Voidling
passive.description: Every few spells, Malzahar summons an uncontrollable Voidling to engage his enemies. Voidlings grow over time, gaining armor, damage, and attack speed.

spells.name: Call of the Void
spells.description: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.
spells.tooltip: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>silence</status> enemies for {{ silenceduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Null Zone
spells.description: Malzahar creates a zone of negative energy that damages nearby enemies each second.
spells.tooltip: Malzahar creates a zone of negative energy for {{ zoneduration }} seconds, which damages nearby enemies for <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} max Health magic damage</magicDamage> each second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Malefic Visions
spells.description: Malzahar infects his target's mind, dealing damage over time. If the target dies during this time, the visions pass to a nearby enemy and Malzahar gains mana.
spells.tooltip:
Malzahar infects his target's mind, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over {{ duration }} seconds. If the target dies during this time, the visions pass to a nearby enemy and Malzahar gains {{ manarestore }} Mana.

Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Nether Grasp
spells.description: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress target champion while dealing magic damage over time.
spells.tooltip: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to <status>suppress</status> target champion, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ suppressduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_MasterYi.name: Master Yi
Jade_MasterYi.title: The Wuju Bladesman
Jade_MasterYi.lore:
- Wuju Style (E) passive increases attack damage doubled when active
- Double Strike (P) is percent chance based
- Alpha Strike (Q) can not be directed after finishing movements
Jade_MasterYi.blurb:
- Wuju Style (E) passive increases attack damage doubled when active
- Double Strike (P) is percent chance based
- Alpha Strike (Q) can not be directed after finishing movements

passive.name: Double Strike
passive.description: Master Yi occassionaly strikes twice.

spells.name: Alpha Strike
spells.description: Master Yi leaps across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path. Alpha strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to minions and monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.
spells.tooltip: Master Yi leaps across the battlefield striking up to 4 enemies, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to each enemy with a {{ monsterdamageprocchance*100 }}% chance to deal <magicDamage>{{ totalmonsterdamage }} bonus magic damage</magicDamage> to minions and monsters.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Meditate
spells.description: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time.
spells.tooltip: Master Yi channels, restoring <healing>{{ totalheal }} Health</healing> over {{ duration }} seconds. While channeling, Master Yi gains <scaleArmor>{{ defensestat }} Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Wuju Style
spells.description: Master Yi becomes skilled in the art of Wuju, passively increasing his Attack Damage.  Activating Wuju Style grants bonus true damage on basic attacks, but the passive bonus is then lost while on cooldown.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Master Yi gains {{ passivead }} Attack Damage.

Active: Master Yi gains {{ passivead*2 }} Attack Damage for {{ duration }} seconds but loses the passive bonus until it comes off of cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Highlander
spells.description: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Movement and Attack speeds as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extends Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.
spells.tooltip:
Increases Master Yi's Movement Speed by {{ rmsbonus*100 }}% and Attack Speed by {{ rasbonus*100 }}%, and he becomes immune to all slowing effects for {{ rduration }} seconds.

While active, killing a champion refreshes all of Master Yi's cooldowns (assists reduce half of the base cooldown amount).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_MissFortune.name: Miss Fortune
Jade_MissFortune.title: The Bounty Hunter
Jade_MissFortune.lore:
- Strut (P) moved from W
- Impure Shots (W) passive deals magic damage on each hit with active increasing attack speed and applying grievous wounds
Jade_MissFortune.blurb:
- Strut (P) moved from W
- Impure Shots (W) passive deals magic damage on each hit with active increasing attack speed and applying grievous wounds

passive.name: Strut
passive.description: Miss Fortune has increased Movement Speed until she is hit in combat.

spells.name: Double Up
spells.description: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them.
spells.tooltip: Miss Fortune fires a shot at an enemy target, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and <physicalDamage>{{ totalricochetdamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to another enemy target behind the first. Applies on-hit effects.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Impure Shots
spells.description: Miss Fortune passively increases damage dealt to a target with each strike.  This ability can be activated to increase Miss Fortune's Attack Speed and cause her attacks to lower healing received by the target.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Miss Fortune deals {{ totaldamageonhit }} magic damage to her target with each attack, cumulatively stacking up to {{ maxstacks }} times on the same target.
Maximum bonus damage: {{ maximumtotaldamageonhit }}

Active: Miss Fortune's Attack Speed is increased by {{ asmod }}% for {{ activeduration }} seconds and causes her attacks to apply 50% Grievous Wounds for 3 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Make It Rain
spells.description: Miss Fortune unleashes a flurry of bullets at a location, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.
spells.tooltip: Miss Fortune fires hundreds of bullets into the air that rain down, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ duration }} seconds and <status>Slowing</status> enemies by {{ movespeedmod*-100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bullet Time
spells.description: Miss Fortune channels a flurry of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies.
spells.tooltip: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her for {{ channelduration }} seconds, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ physicaldamageperwave }} physical damage</physicalDamage> per bullet (<physicalDamage>Total Damage: {{ totaldamage }}</physicalDamage>).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Soul Siphon
passive.description: Morgana has Spell Vamp, healing herself whenever she deals damage with her spells.

spells.name: Dark Binding
spells.description: Morgana releases a sphere of dark magic.  Upon contact with an enemy unit, the sphere will deal magic damage and force the unit to the ground for a period of time.
spells.tooltip: Fires a bolt of dark energy, <status>Rooting</status> the first enemy hit for {{ rootduration }} seconds, and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage.</magicDamage></mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tormented Soil
spells.description: Infects an area with desecrated soil, causing enemy units who stand on the location to take continual damage.
spells.tooltip: Curses an area for {{ duration }} seconds. Enemies on the cursed ground take <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and have their <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> reduced by {{ mrshredtooltip }} every second.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Black Shield
spells.description: Places a protective barrier around an allied champion, absorbing magical damage and disables until penetrated or the shield dissipates.
spells.tooltip: Shields an allied Champion for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. The shield absorbs <shield>{{ totalshieldstrength }}</shield> <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> and prevents <status>Disables</status> until it breaks.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Soul Shackles
spells.description: Latches chains of energy onto nearby enemy champions, dealing initial damage to them and slowing their Movement Speed, and then echoing the pain a few seconds later and stunning them if they remain close to Morgana.
spells.tooltip:
Dark chains latch onto nearby enemy Champions dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing them by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}%. After {{ chainduration }} seconds, they are dealt an additional {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and are stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds.

Enemy Champions can break the chains by moving away from Morgana.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Surging Tides
passive.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

spells.name: Aqua Prison
spells.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.
spells.tooltip: Sends a bubble towards a targeted area, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagett }} magic damage</magicDamage> to enemies, and stunning them for {{ stunduration }} seconds{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ebb and Flow
spells.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allies and enemies, healing allies and damaging enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allies and enemies.

On Ally Hit: Heals {{ totalheal }} health and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion.

On Enemy Hit: Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and bounces to a nearby allied champion.

Bounces to each target only once, and hits up to {{ maxtargets }} targets. The damage is reduced by {{ bouncescaling*100 }}% and the healing is reduced by {{ healbouncescaling*100 }}% each bounce.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
spells.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.
spells.tooltip: Empowers an allied champion for {{ buffduration }} seconds or {{ hitcount }} basic attacks. The ally's basic attacks deal <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} bonus magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slow</status> the target by {{ baseslow*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tidal Wave
spells.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Summons a Tidal Wave from Nami's position.

The Tidal Wave Knocks Up enemies and Slows them by {{ slowamount*100 }}%, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. The duration of the Slow increases based on how far the Tidal Wave has traveled, with a minimum duration of {{ minslowduration }} seconds and a maximum of {{ maxslowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Nasus.name: Nasus
Jade_Nasus.title: The Curator of the Sands
Jade_Nasus.lore: - Fury of the Sands (R) magic damage temporarily converts a percentage into Attack Damage
Jade_Nasus.blurb: - Fury of the Sands (R) magic damage temporarily converts a percentage into Attack Damage

passive.name: Soul Eater
passive.description: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Lifesteal.

spells.name: Siphoning Strike
spells.description: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.
spells.tooltip: Nasus's next Attack deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. Killing an enemy with this Attack permanently increases its damage by {{ basicstacks }}, increased to {{ bigstacks }} against champions, large minions and large monsters.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Wither
spells.description: Nasus ages his target, decelerating their Movement and Attack Speeds over time.
spells.tooltip: Nasus ages target champion over {{ duration }} seconds, initially <status>Slowing</status> their Movement Speed by {{ slowbase }}% increasing to {{ maxslowtooltiponly }}% and Attack Speed by {{ attackspeedbasetotal }}% increasing to {{ attackspeedmaxtotal }}%  over the duration.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spirit Fire
spells.description: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.
spells.tooltip:
Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a target location, dealing an initial {{ initialdamage }} magic damage.

For the next {{ duration }} seconds, enemies in the area have their Armor reduced by {{ totalarmorshred }} and are dealt an additional {{ tickdotdamage }} magic damage each second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Fury of the Sands
spells.description: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, cast ranges, and drains nearby enemies' max Health converting into bonus damage for the duration.
spells.tooltip:
Nasus becomes empowered in the sandstorm for {{ duration }} seconds, increasing his Maximum Health by {{ bonushealth }}, Attack Range by {{ attackrangeincrease }}, and Cast Ranges by 100.

While the storm rages, he deals {{ damagecalc }} of enemy Maximum Health magic damage ({{ maxdamagecap }} damage max per second) and converts {{ damagetoad*100 }}% into bonus Attack Damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Nautilus.name: Nautilus
Jade_Nautilus.lore: - Nautilus's changes lie forgotten at the bottom of the ocean
Jade_Nautilus.blurb: - Nautilus's changes lie forgotten at the bottom of the ocean

passive.name: Staggering Blow
passive.description: Nautilus' basic attacks deal bonus physical damage and immoblize his targets. This effect cannot happen more than once every few seconds on the same target.

spells.name: Dredge Line
spells.description: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. If it hits a champion, he drags both himself and the opponent close together. If it hits terrain, Nautilus instead pulls himself to the anchor and the cooldown of Dredge Line is reduced.
spells.tooltip:
Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. If it hits an enemy, Nautilus drags himself and the target together, dealing {{ qdamagecalc }} magic damage and Stunning them briefly.

Hitting terrain instead Pulls Nautilus forward and reduces this ability's cooldown by {{ terraincdr*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Titan's Wrath
spells.description: Nautilus gains a temporary Shield.  While it persists, his Attacks deal damage over time to his target and surrounding enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Nautilus surrounds himself with dark energies, granting him {{ shieldcalc }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

While the Shield persists, Nautilus' Attacks deal {{ dotdamagecalc }} magic damage over {{ dotduration }} seconds to the target and surrounding enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Riptide
spells.description: Nautilus slams the ground, causing the earth to explode around him in a set of three explosions. Each explosion damages and slows enemies.
spells.tooltip: Nautilus slams the ground, creating three explosions that each deal <magicDamage>{{ damagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slow</status> enemies by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds. A unit can be hit by more than one explosion, but they take <magicDamage>{{ damagehalvedtooltip }} damage</magicDamage> from additional explosions.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Depth Charge
spells.description: Nautilus fires a shockwave into the earth that chases an opponent. This shockwave rips up the earth above it, knocking enemies into the air. When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.
spells.tooltip: Nautilus fires a shockwave that chases an enemy champion, dealing <magicDamage>{{ primarytargetdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Knocking Up</status> and <status>Stunning</status> them for {{ stunduration }} seconds. Other enemies hit by the shockwave are also <status>Knocked Up</status>, <status>Stunned</status> and take <magicDamage>{{ secondarytargetdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Nidalee.name: Nidalee
Jade_Nidalee.title: The Bestial Huntress
Jade_Nidalee.lore:
- Aspect of the Cougar (R) does not start with a level
- Prowl (P) has Hunt passive removed
- Bushwhack (W) does insane damage
Jade_Nidalee.blurb:
- Aspect of the Cougar (R) does not start with a level
- Prowl (P) has Hunt passive removed
- Bushwhack (W) does insane damage

passive.name: Prowl
passive.description: Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Movement Speed.

spells.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
spells.description: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies.  As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.
spells.tooltip:
Human: Nidalee tosses her javelin, dealing between {{ startingdamage }} and {{ maxdamage }} magic damage on impact based on how far Nidalee is away from the target.

Cougar: Nidalee's next attack deals between {{ spell.jade_nidaleeaspectofthecougar:totaltakedowndamage }} and {{ spell.jade_nidaleeaspectofthecougar:totaltakedownmaximumdamage }} physical damage based on the target's missing Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
spells.description: In human form, Nidalee lays a damaging trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages, reveals, reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist. As a cougar, she pounces forward, dealing a small amount of damage when she lands.
spells.tooltip:
Human: Nidalee lays a trap that deals {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage over {{ damageduration }} seconds, reveals the target, and shreds their Armor and Magic Resist by {{ resistdecreases*100 }}% for {{ shredduration }} seconds. Traps last for {{ trapdurationmins }} minutes.

Cougar: Nidalee lunges forward, dealing {{ spell.jade_nidaleeaspectofthecougar:totalpouncedamage }} magic damage to surrounding enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
spells.description: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with attack speed for a short duration.  As a cougar, she rapidly claws enemies in front of her.
spells.tooltip:
Human: Nidalee heals an allied champion for {{ totalhealing }} and grants them {{ bonusas*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ asduration }} seconds.

Cougar: Nidalee claws at enemies in front of her, dealing {{ spell.jade_nidaleeaspectofthecougar:totalswipedamage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
spells.description: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities and increased Movement Speed.
spells.tooltip:
Human: Nidalee transforms into a vicious cougar, gaining {{ cougarmovespeed }} Movement Speed, and her basic abilities become Takedown, Pounce, and Swipe.

Cougar: Nidalee transforms back into human form.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Nunu.name: Nunu & Willump
Jade_Nunu.title: The Yeti Rider
Jade_Nunu.lore:
- Blood Boil (W) grants attack and movement speed
- Ice Blast (E) a single point and click snowball
- Consume (Q) can't target champions but gain buffs based on whats eaten
- Visionary (P) every 5 basic attacks the next spell costs no mana - Nunu & Willump get an extra line as they are 2 characters
Jade_Nunu.blurb:
- Blood Boil (W) grants attack and movement speed
- Ice Blast (E) a single point and click snowball
- Consume (Q) can't target champions but gain buffs based on whats eaten
- Visionary (P) every 5 basic attacks the next spell costs no mana -...

passive.name: Visionary
passive.description: Nunu can cast a spell for free after several attacks.

spells.name: Consume
spells.description: Nunu commands the yeti to take a bite out of a target minion or monster, dealing heavy damage to it and healing himself.
spells.tooltip:
Commands the yeti to bite out of a minion or monster, dealing {{ basedamage }} true damage to the target and healing himself for {{ totalhealing }}.

Nunu gains bonuses for {{ consumeduration }} seconds based on what he consumed.

Wolves or Reptiles: Your attacks and spells deal an additional {{ reptiledamage }} magic damage.
Golems: {{ golemsizebonus*100 }}% increased Size and {{ golemhealthbonus*100 }}% Maximum Health.
Wraiths: Killing a unit grants {{ wraithmovespeed*100 }}% Movement Speed for {{ wraithmovespeedduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Blood Boil
spells.description: Nunu invigorates himself and an allied unit by heating their blood, increasing their Movement and Attack Speeds.
spells.tooltip: The heat of Nunu and a target ally's blood rises, increasing <speed>Movement Speed by {{ movespeed*100 }}%</speed> and <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by {{ attackspeed*100 }}%</attackSpeed> for {{ buffduration }} seconds. Nunu may target themself.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ice Blast
spells.description: Nunu launches a ball of ice at an enemy unit, dealing damage and temporarily slowing their Movement and Attack Speeds.
spells.tooltip: Nunu launches a ball of ice at an enemy unit, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> their Movement Speed by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% and Attack Speed by {{ attackspeedmod*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Absolute Zero
spells.description: Nunu begins to sap the area of heat, slowing all nearby enemies. When the spell ends, he deals massive damage to all enemies caught in the area.
spells.tooltip:
Nunu saps the area of heat, channeling while enemies within the zone are Slowed by {{ movementspeedmod*-100 }}% and their Attack Speed is reduced by {{ attackspeedmod*-100 }}%.

Enemies caught in the area when the channel ends receive up to {{ totaldamage }} magic damage, depending on how long the spell was channeled.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Olaf.name: Olaf
Jade_Olaf.title: The Berserker
Jade_Olaf.lore:
- Vicious Strikes (W) grants Attack Damage, Lifesteal and Spell Vamp
- Reckless Swing (E) does not heal the health cost
Jade_Olaf.blurb:
- Vicious Strikes (W) grants Attack Damage, Lifesteal and Spell Vamp
- Reckless Swing (E) does not heal the health cost

passive.name: Berserker Rage
passive.description: Olaf's Attack Speed increases as his Health decreases.

spells.name: Undertow
spells.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to units it passes through and slowing their movement speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reduced.
spells.tooltip:
Olaf throws an axe to a target location, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to units it passes through and Slowing them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% over {{ debuffduration }} seconds.

If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reduced by {{ cooldownrefund }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Vicious Strikes
spells.description: Olaf's attack damage is increased, based on his health, and he gains massive lifesteal and spell vamp.
spells.tooltip: Olaf gains <physicalDamage>{{ totaladgain }} Attack Damage</physicalDamage> , {{ lifestealamount*100 }}% Lifesteal, and Spell Vamp for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Reckless Swing
spells.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself.
spells.tooltip: Olaf ferociously swings his axes, dealing <trueDamage>{{ totaldamage }} true damage</trueDamage> to his target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ragnarok
spells.description: Olaf temporarily becomes immune to disables and gains bonus Armor, Magic Resist, and Lethality.
spells.tooltip:
Active: Olaf cleanses all Immobilizing and Disabling effects on himself and becomes immune to them the next {{ duration }} seconds. During this time, Olaf gains {{ resists }} Armor and {{ resists }} Magic Resist.

Passive: Olaf gains an additional {{ armorpen }} Lethality.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Pantheon.name: Pantheon
Jade_Pantheon.title: The Artisan of War
Jade_Pantheon.lore:
- Aegis Protection (P) blocks damage after casting multiple times
- Grand Skyfall (R) is a circle AoE
- Heartseeker Strike (E) - Pantheon stands still and strikes
Jade_Pantheon.blurb:
- Aegis Protection (P) blocks damage after casting multiple times
- Grand Skyfall (R) is a circle AoE
- Heartseeker Strike (E) - Pantheon stands still and strikes

skins.name: Chosen of the Wolf Pantheon (Rose Quartz)

passive.name: Aegis Protection
passive.description: After every @AttacksRequired@ attacks or spell casts, Pantheon gains protection from the next attack.

spells.name: Spear Shot
spells.description: Pantheon hurls his spear at an opponent, dealing damage.
spells.tooltip: Pantheon hurls his spear at an opponent, dealing<physicalDamage> {{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Aegis of Zeonia
spells.description: Pantheon leaps at an enemy and bashes the enemy with his shield, stunning them. After finishing the attack, Pantheon readies himself to block the next attack.
spells.tooltip: Pantheon leaps at the target enemy and deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stuns</status> them for {{ stunduration }} second(s). Pantheon also instantly refreshes his <spellName>Aegis Protection</spellName>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Heartseeker Strike
spells.description: Pantheon focuses and unleashes swift strikes to the area in front of him, dealing increased damage to champions. Pantheon also becomes more aware of his enemy's vital spots, allowing him to critically strike against wounded enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Spear Shot, Heartseeker Strike, and Pantheon's basic attacks critically strike against targets below {{ passivecritthreshold*100 }}% health.

Active: Pantheon channels and deals {{ numberofstrikes }} swift strikes to the area in front of him for {{ totaldamage }} physical damage per strike (total {{ maximumdamagetooltip }}).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Grand Skyfall
spells.description: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air to a target, striking all enemy units in an area. Enemies closer to the impact point take more damage.
spells.tooltip: Pantheon gathers his strength and then leaps high into the air, crashing down at the target area a few seconds later. Deals up to <magicDamage>{{ maxdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to units at the center (down to <magicDamage>{{ mindamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> at the edge) and <status>Slows</status> them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Poppy.name: Poppy
Jade_Poppy.title: The Iron Ambassador
Jade_Poppy.lore:
- Heroic Charge (E) uses ability power scaling
- Passive, Q, W, R are completely different. Read the ability descriptions
Jade_Poppy.blurb:
- Heroic Charge (E) uses ability power scaling
- Passive, Q, W, R are completely different. Read the ability descriptions

passive.name: Valiant Fighter
passive.description: Damage dealt to Poppy that exceeds a portion of her current health is reduced.

spells.name: Devastating Blow
spells.description: Poppy's next attack crushes her opponent, dealing bonus damage based on her target's max health.
spells.tooltip: Poppy's next attack deals <magicDamage>{{ flatdamagecalc }} + {{ healthratio*100 }}% maximum Health magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Paragon of Demacia
spells.description: Passive: Upon receiving damage from or dealing damage with a basic attack, Poppy's armor and damage are increased, which can stack. Active: Poppy gains max stacks of Paragon of Demacia increased movement speed.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Poppy gains {{ bonusstats }} Armor and Attack Damage for {{ passiveduration }} seconds whenever she deals or takes Attack damage. This effect can stack {{ maxstacks }} times.

Active: Poppy gains max stacks of Paragon of Demacia and her movement speed is increased by {{ speed*100 }}% for {{ activeduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Heroic Charge
spells.description: Poppy charges at an enemy and carries them further. The initial impact deals a small amount of damage, and if they collide with terrain, her target will take a high amount of damage and be stunned.
spells.tooltip: Poppy charges at an enemy, dealing <magicDamage>{{ initialdamagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> and carrying them a short distance. If they collide with terrain, her target takes an additional <magicDamage>{{ walldamagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> and will be <status>stunned</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Diplomatic Immunity
spells.description: Poppy focuses intently on a single enemy champion, dealing increased damage to them. Poppy is immune to any damage and abilities from enemies other than her target.
spells.tooltip: Poppy singles out her most important foe. For {{ duration }} seconds, Poppy deals {{ damagemulti }}% increased damage to them and is <status>Immune</status> to all other enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Rammus.name: Rammus
Jade_Rammus.title: The Armordillo
Jade_Rammus.lore:
- Tremors (R) is a repeating AoE around him
- All other abilities are ok
Jade_Rammus.blurb:
- Tremors (R) is a repeating AoE around him
- All other abilities are ok

passive.name: Spiked Shell
passive.description: Rammus gains additional damage as his shell becomes reinforced, converting a portion of his Armor into Attack Damage.

spells.name: Powerball
spells.description: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.
spells.tooltip:
Rammus accelerates in a ball over {{ duration }}s towards his enemies, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies on impact and Slowing them by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s.

Recast to remove this effect.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Defensive Ball Curl
spells.description: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his armor and magic resistance, while returning damage to attacks.
spells.tooltip:
Rammus goes into a defensive formation for {{ duration }}s, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist by {{ armour }} and returning {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to attackers.

Recast to remove this effect.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Puncturing Taunt
spells.description: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against Rammus' hard shell, reducing Armor temporarily.
spells.tooltip: Rammus <status>Taunts</status> the enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault, reducing their Armor by {{ armourreduction*-1 }} and forcing them to attack Rammus for {{ duration }} second(s).</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tremors
spells.description: Rammus creates waves of destruction pulsing through the ground, causing damage to units and structures near him.
spells.tooltip: Rammus creates tremors beneath him, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> every second to nearby units and structures for {{ duration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Ryze.name: Ryze
Jade_Ryze.title: The Rogue Mage
Jade_Ryze.lore: - The Abilities are completely different (for the 5th time)
Jade_Ryze.blurb: - The Abilities are completely different (for the 5th time)

passive.name: Arcane Mastery
passive.description: Ryze's abilities reduce the cooldown of all other abilities.

spells.name: Overload
spells.description:
Passive: Ryze permanently gains Cooldown Reduction.

Active: Ryze unleashes an orb of energy, dealing magic damage to his target.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Ryze permanently gains {{ passivecooldown*100 }}% Cooldown Reduction.

Active: Ryze unleashes an orb of energy, dealing {{ damagecalc }} magic damage to his target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rune Prison
spells.description: Ryze magically imprisons an enemy, <status>rooting</status> them and dealing <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage>.
spells.tooltip: Ryze magically imprisons an enemy, <status>rooting</status> them for {{ ccduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ damagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spell Flux
spells.description: Ryze fires a chaotic bolt of magic that can bounce between enemies, dealing <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> and reducing their <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>.
spells.tooltip: Ryze fires a chaotic bolt of magic that can bounce between enemies or himself up to {{ maximumhits }} times, dealing <magicDamage>{{ damagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> to enemies and reducing their <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> by {{ resistshred }}.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Desperate Power
spells.description: Ryze temporary harnesses his full powers, gaining <magicDamage>area of effect damage</magicDamage> on all abilities, <healing>Spell Vamp</healing>, and <speed>Move Speed</speed> for a short time.
spells.tooltip: Ryze temporary harnesses his full powers, gaining <magicDamage>{{ areadamagemod*100 }}% area of effect damage</magicDamage> on all abilities, <healing>{{ spellvamp*100 }}% Spell Vamp</healing>, and <speed>{{ movementspeed }} Move Speed</speed> for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Shaco.name: Shaco
Jade_Shaco.title: The Demon Jester
Jade_Shaco.lore:
- Hallucinate (R) clone explodes dealing more damage but doesn't spawn boxes
- Jack in the box (W) can be placed closer together
Jade_Shaco.blurb:
- Hallucinate (R) clone explodes dealing more damage but doesn't spawn boxes
- Jack in the box (W) can be placed closer together

passive.name: Backstab
passive.description: Shaco's Attacks and abilities deal bonus damage from behind.

spells.name: Deceive
spells.description: Shaco becomes invisible and teleports to target location. His next attack is guaranteed to critically strike.
spells.tooltip:
Shaco teleports nearby and becomes Invisible for {{ stealthduration }} seconds.

His next basic attack within the next {{ enhancedattackduration }} seconds will critically strike for {{ modifiedqcritdamagetooltip }} damage.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Jack In The Box
spells.description: Shaco creates an animated Jack-in-the-Box at target location, which will wait, invisible, to Fear nearby units and attack them when some come nearby.
spells.tooltip:
Shaco creates a trap that becomes Invisible after {{ stealthtimer }} seconds and lasts for {{ trapduration }} seconds. It activates when an enemy comes near Fearing nearby enemies for {{ fearduration }} seconds.

Once activated, the trap fires at nearby enemies for {{ traptriggeredlifetime }} seconds, dealing {{ boxtotaldamage_jade }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Two-Shiv Poison
spells.description: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing them and applying a miss chance to minions. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: While this Ability is off Cooldown, Shaco's Attacks Slow the target by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% for {{ slowdurationpassive }} seconds. Also reduces minions' chance to hit by {{ misschance*100 }}% for {{ slowdurationpassive }} seconds.

Active: Shaco throws a shiv, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to target enemy and Slowing by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% for {{ slowdurationactive }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hallucinate
spells.description: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies. Upon death, it explodes, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Shaco vanishes briefly and reappears with a clone that lasts up to {{ clonelifetime }} seconds. The clone deals {{ cloneaadamagepercent*100 }}% of Shaco's damage and receives {{ clonebonusdamagetakentooltip }} increased damage.

On death, the clone detonates, dealing {{ explosiontotaldamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Shen.name: Shen
Jade_Shen.title: Eye of Twilight
Jade_Shen.lore:
- Ki Strike (Passive) and Vorpal Blade (Q) are different abilities
- Feint (W) grants a shield for a short duration
- Shadow Dash (E) only hits champions
Jade_Shen.blurb:
- Ki Strike (Passive) and Vorpal Blade (Q) are different abilities
- Feint (W) grants a shield for a short duration
- Shadow Dash (E) only hits champions

passive.name: Ki Strike
passive.description: Periodically, Shen's next attack deals bonus damage. Each time Shen attacks a minion, monster, or champion, Ki Strike's cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Vorpal Blade
spells.description: Damages target unit and life taps him, healing allies that attack the target.
spells.tooltip: Shen throws a vorpal blade, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totalmagicdamage_jade }} magic damage</magicDamage> to target unit, marking them for {{ markduration_jade }} seconds. Allied spells and attacks against this target heal them for <healing>{{ totalhealovertimeamount_jade }}</healing> over {{ healduration_jade }} seconds. Killing an enemy with this Ability restores <healing>{{ totalheal_jade }} Health</healing> instantly instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Feint
spells.description: Shen shields himself, absorbing incoming damage for a few seconds.
spells.tooltip: Shen grants himself <shield>{{ totalshieldamount }} Shield</shield> for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. While this Ability holds, his attacks reduce <keywordMajor>Ki Strike's</keywordMajor> Cooldown by an additional {{ passivecooldownreduction }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shadow Dash
spells.description: Shen dashes rapidly toward a target location, taunting enemy champions he encounters and dealing minor damage.
spells.tooltip: Shen dashes, <status>Taunting</status> for {{ tauntduration }} second(s) and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldashdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> on collision with enemy champions. <status>Taunted</status> champions are forced to attack Shen and deal {{ physdamagereductionratio*100 }}% reduced physical damage. Restores <keywordMajor>{{ energyrestore }} Energy</keywordMajor> per champion affected.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Stand United
spells.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.
spells.tooltip: Shen grants an allied champion <shield>{{ totalshield }} Shield</shield> for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. After channeling for {{ channelduration }} seconds, Shen Teleports to his ally's location.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Shyvana.name: Shyvana
Jade_Shyvana.title: The Half-Dragon
Jade_Shyvana.lore:
- Dragon's Descent (R) has a different passive and properties
- Passive, Q, W, E are completely different, including Dragon Form abilities. Read the ability descriptions
Jade_Shyvana.blurb:
- Dragon's Descent (R) has a different passive and properties
- Passive, Q, W, E are completely different, including Dragon Form abilities. Read the ability descriptions

passive.name: Fury of the Dragonborn
passive.description: Shyvana's basic attacks enhance her abilities.

spells.name: Twin Bite
spells.description: Shyvana strikes twice on her next attack. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Twin Bite. Dragon Form: Twin Bite cleaves all units in front Shyvana.
spells.tooltip:
Shyvana strikes twice on her next attack, dealing {{ calc_bonus_damage }} physical damage on the second attack. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Twin Bite by {{ cooldown_reduction }} seconds.

Dragon Form: Twin Bite cleaves all units in front of Shyvana.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Burnout
spells.description: Shyvana surrounds herself in fire, dealing magic damage per second to nearby enemies and briefly moving faster. The movement speed reduces over the duration of the spell. Basic attacks extend the duration of Burnout. Dragon Form: Burnout scorches the ground beneath it, enemies on the scorched earth continue to take damage.
spells.tooltip:
Shyvana deals {{ damage }} magic damage per second to nearby enemies and moves {{ basemovespeed*100 }}% faster for {{ movespeedduration }} seconds. Shyvana's Move Speed bonus is reduced over time. Basic attacks extend the duration of Burnout by {{ durationincreaseperhit }} second to a maximum of {{ maxdurationincrease }} seconds.

Dragon Form: Burnout scorches the earth, continuing to damage enemies that stand on it.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Flame Breath
spells.description: Shyvana unleashes a fireball that deals damage to all enemies it encounters and leaves cinders on the target briefly marking them. Basic attacks on marked targets deal a percentage of their maximum health as damage on-hit. Dragon Form: Flame Breath engulfs all units in a cone in front of her.
spells.tooltip:
Shyvana unleashes a fireball that deals {{ damage }} magic damage to targets hit, debuffing them and reducing their Armor by {{ armorshred*100 }}% for {{ debuffduration }} seconds. Basic attacks to debuffed targets deal {{ bonusdamage }} magic damage On-Hit.

Dragon Form: Flame Breath fires in a cone in front of her.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dragon's Descent
spells.description: Shyvana transforms into a dragon and takes flight to a target location. Enemies along her path take damage and are knocked toward her target location. Shyvana passively gains Armor and Magic Resistance. Defensive bonuses are doubled in Dragon Form.
spells.tooltip:
Active: Shyvana transforms into a dragon and takes flight to a target location. Enemies along her path take {{ damage }} magic damage and are knocked toward her target location.

Passive: Shyvana reinforces her scales, increasing her Armor and Magic Resist by {{ seasonone_armormrgain }}. Defensive bonuses are doubled in Dragon Form.

While in Dragon Form Shyvana's abilities have additional effects.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Singed.name: Singed
Jade_Singed.title: The Mad Chemist
Jade_Singed.lore: - Empowered Bulwark (P) gains health with Mana
Jade_Singed.blurb: - Empowered Bulwark (P) gains health with Mana

passive.name: Empowered Bulwark
passive.description: Increases Singed's Health based on his maximum Mana.

spells.name: Poison Trail
spells.description: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.
spells.tooltip: <toggle>Toggle: </toggle>Singed lays a poisonous trail that deals <magicDamage>{{ damagepersecond }} magic damage</magicDamage> per second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Mega Adhesive
spells.description: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing enemies who walk on it.
spells.tooltip: Leaves a sticky area on the ground for {{ wduration }} seconds, <status>Slowing</status> enemies in the area by {{ slowpercent }}% (lasts {{ slowduration }} seconds after leaving).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Fling
spells.description: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed.
spells.tooltip: Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing <magicDamage>{{ damage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Insanity Potion
spells.description: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats.
spells.tooltip: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him <magicDamage>{{ statamount }} Ability Power</magicDamage>, <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor>, <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>, <speed>Movement Speed</speed>, <healing>Health Regeneration</healing>, and <scaleMana>Mana Regeneration</scaleMana> for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Sion.name: Sion
Jade_Sion.title: The Undead Champion
Jade_Sion.lore:
- The Abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions
- Sion has Ability Power and Attack Damage builds
- Damage dealer not a Juggernaut
Jade_Sion.blurb:
- The Abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions
- Sion has Ability Power and Attack Damage builds
- Damage dealer not a Juggernaut

passive.name: Feel No Pain
passive.description: Sion has a chance to ignore some damage each time he is attacked.

spells.name: Cryptic Gaze
spells.description: Sion's stare terrifies a single enemy, dealing damage and stunning them.
spells.tooltip: Sion blasts a single enemy, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stunning</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Death's Caress
spells.description: Sion surrounds himself with a damage-absorbing shield.  If the shield is not destroyed it will explode, damaging surrounding enemies. Sion can reactivate the ability to detonate the shield early.
spells.tooltip:
Sion surrounds himself with a shield which absorbs {{ totalshield }} damage. If the shield is not destroyed in {{ shieldduration }} seconds, it will explode, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Recast after {{ recastdelay }} seconds to manually detonate.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Enrage
spells.description: While active Sion gains Attack Damage at the cost of Health on each basic attack. Additonally, he permanently increases his maximum Health whenever he kills a unit.
spells.tooltip:
Toggle: Sion's Attack Damage is increased by {{ bonusdamage }} and he permanently gains {{ hpgainreduced }} maximum Health per kill. This bonus is doubled against Champions, large minions and large monsters

Total Health gained: +{{ f1 }}{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Cannibalism
spells.description: Sion consumes some of his enemies' life force on each attack, leeching health to himself and nearby allies. The smell of flesh also renews Sion's fervor, increasing his Attack Speed.
spells.tooltip: Sion gains <lifeSteal>{{ lifestealpercent*100 }}% Lifesteal</lifeSteal> and <attackSpeed>{{ attackspeedmod*100 }}% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for {{ buffduration }} seconds. Additionally, Sion's basic attacks <healing>heal</healing> surrounding allies for {{ healpercent*100 }}% of the damage dealt.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Sivir.name: Sivir
Jade_Sivir.title: The Battle Mistress
Jade_Sivir.lore:
- Ricochet (W) toggles bouncing randomly attacks
- Spell Shield (E) gain mana instead of health when triggered
Jade_Sivir.blurb:
- Ricochet (W) toggles bouncing randomly attacks
- Spell Shield (E) gain mana instead of health when triggered

passive.name: Fleet of Foot
passive.description: Sivir gains a short burst of Movement Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

spells.name: Boomerang Blade
spells.description: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.
spells.tooltip: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, which deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to the first unit and {{ falloffratio*100 }}% reduced damage to each subsequent target down to a minimum of {{ falloffminimum*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ricochet
spells.description: Sivir's next basic attack will bounce between targets, dealing reduced damage with each successive hit.
spells.tooltip: Sivir's basic attack will bounce to <attention>{{ maxbounces }}</attention> additional targets, dealing {{ falloffratio*100 }}% less damage with each bounce.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spell Shield
spells.description: Sivir creates a magical barrier on herself that blocks a single enemy ability. She regains Mana if an ability is successfully blocked.
spells.tooltip: Sivir creates a spell shield for {{ duration }} seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy ability. If an ability is blocked by the shield, Sivir regains <scaleMana>{{ manareturn }} Mana</scaleMana>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: On The Hunt
spells.description: Sivir leads her allies into battle granting them increased Movement and Attack Speeds for a period of time.
spells.tooltip: Sivir's battle prowess emanates for {{ ultduration }} seconds, increasing her <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by {{ huntattackspeed*100 }}%</attackSpeed> and <speed>Movement Speed by {{ ms*100 }}%</speed>. Nearby allies gain {{ alliedeffectiveness*100 }}% of Sivir's benefits for the duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Jade_Skarner.name: Skarner
Jade_Skarner.title: The Crystal Vanguard
Jade_Skarner.lore:
- The Abilities are completely different
- Bruiser and auto attacker
- Impale (R) is a single target point and click
Jade_Skarner.blurb:
- The Abilities are completely different
- Bruiser and auto attacker
- Impale (R) is a single target point and click

passive.name: Energize
passive.description: Basic attacks reduce all ability cooldowns. This effect is stronger against champions.

spells.name: Crystal Slash
spells.description: Skarner lashes out with his claws, dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies and charging himself with Crystal Energy for several seconds if a unit is struck. spells.tooltip:

SummonerSmite_Jade.name: Smite
SummonerSmite_Jade.description: Deals true damage to target enemy minion or pet. Summoner's Resolve: Smite grants 10 gold per cast.

SummonerRally_Jade.name: Rally

SummonerBattleCry_Jade.name: Surge
SummonerBattleCry_Jade.description: Temporarily empowers your champion, granting Attack Speed  and Ability Power for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: Increases the Attack Speed bonus by 5% and the Ability Power bonus by 10%.

SummonerFortify_Jade.name: Fortify

SummonerBarrier_Jade.name: Barrier
SummonerBarrier_Jade.description: Gain a short duration shield. Summoner's Resolve: Barrier's Shield is increased.

SummonerRevive_Jade.name: Revive
SummonerRevive_Jade.description: Instantly revives your champion at your team's Summoner Platform and increases their Movement Speed for a short duration. Summoner's Insight: Revive temporarily grants the user 220-560 Health.

SummonerTeleport_Jade.name: Teleport
SummonerTeleport_Jade.description: After a short channel, your champion teleports to a target allied minion, turret, or ward. Summoner's Insight: Teleport's channel time is reduced.

SummonerHaste_Jade.name: Ghost
SummonerHaste_Jade.description: Gain Move Speed and ignore unit collision for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: Bonus Move Speed granted by Ghost is increased.

SummonerFlash_Jade.name: Flash
SummonerFlash_Jade.description: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor. Summoner's Insight: Reduces Flash's Cooldown by 15 seconds.

SummonerDot_Jade.name: Ignite
SummonerDot_Jade.description: Deals true damage over time to target enemy champion and reduces healing effects on them for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: While Ignite is on cooldown, gain 5 Ability Power and Attack Damage.

SummonerBoost_Jade.name: Cleanse
SummonerBoost_Jade.description: Removes all disables and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and temporarily lowers the duration of incoming disables. Summoner's Resolve: Extends the Tenacity buff duration.

SummonerSpell_Promote_Jade.name: Promote
SummonerSpell_Promote_Jade.description: Promotes a minion, granting it bonus stats, an empowering aura, and causing it to grant the caster gold for its kills. Summoner's Wrath: The Siege Rider's bonus Attack Damage aura also affects Champions.

SummonerClairvoyance_Jade.name: Clairvoyance
SummonerClairvoyance_Jade.description: Reveals a small area of the map for your team for a short duration. Summoner's Insight: Retain sight on units revealed by Clairvoyance for 5 seconds.

SummonerMana_Jade.name: Clarity
SummonerMana_Jade.description: Restores your and ally champions' Mana. Summoner's Insight: Restores more mana.

SummonerExhaust_Jade.name: Exhaust
SummonerExhaust_Jade.description: Slows target enemy champion and reduces their Attack Speed and damage dealt. Summoner's Wrath: Exhaust also reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist by 10.

SummonerHeal_Jade.name: Heal
SummonerHeal_Jade.description: Restores Health to your champion and to nearby allies. Summoner's Resolve: Gain 5 Health per level.
